# Data artifacts that scripts/warm_data_cache.py pre-populates into
# ~/.cache/brahe. Hashed into the actions/cache key in the test/integration
# workflows and warm_data_cache.yml, so any change here invalidates and
# reseeds the cache.
#
# NAIF kernels (name resolved via brahe.load_spice_kernel):
de440s
moon_pa_de440
mar099s
# ICGEM gravity models (icgem:<body>:<model name>):
icgem:moon:GRGM660PRIM
icgem:mars:ggm2bc80
# Horizons SPK (Ceres, for the dawn_ceres_orbit example). The body name is the
# SBDB search string and is hashed verbatim into the SBDB cache key, so it must
# match the example's lookup exactly ("Ceres", not "ceres") or the example
# repeats the lookup against a different cache entry:
horizons:Ceres:2015-12-01:2016-03-01
# Celestrak GP groups (celestrak:group:<name>). These are NOT warmed into the
# actions cache: they are committed under test_assets/celestrak and seeded into
# ~/.cache/brahe/celestrak, so examples and doc plots never contact Celestrak.
# The list stays here as the single source of truth for which groups
# scripts/refresh_celestrak_snapshots.py fetches. The examples' single-object
# lookups resolve from the `active` group, and the debris groups back the
# gabbard doc plots' group queries. Refresh with:
#     just refresh-celestrak-snapshots
celestrak:group:active
celestrak:group:starlink
celestrak:group:gps-ops
celestrak:group:cosmos-1408-debris
celestrak:group:fengyun-1c-debris
celestrak:group:iridium-33-debris
celestrak:group:cosmos-2251-debris
